title: Campaign: what low-dimensional structure in human motor cortex is stable across people, years and electrode loss?
abstract: This research campaign asks what low-dimensional structure in human motor cortex population activity is stable across people, years and electrode loss, and what it predicts about brain-computer interface decoding. It builds on Utah-array data from 20 years of BrainGate trials (Hahn et al. 2026) and open DANDI datasets, organised as a tiling tree by what a claim measures: geometry within a session, stability across sessions and people, task-free array measures predicting function, and learned models. No results yet: three pilot studies started on 28 November 2026. Cite the most specific branch to contribute.
